purpose: Chapter 21 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default win/lose check, then forces game-over if either escort NPC at runtime_char[0x10] or [0x11] is dead.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_check_battle_end_condition() for the default win/lose decision, then adds a two-slot lose-condition override: if fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x10) OR fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x11) is true, set data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (@0x53ECC) = 1 (game over). OR short-circuits so 0x11 is only tested when 0x10 is alive. (The decompiler renders this as an inverted-and early-return; logically equivalent via De Morgan.) event_arg is the Watcom __CHK-prologue artifact and is unused by the body.
